news.headline: ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Review: Obefazimod Sustains Week-44 Remission With No Dose-Dependent Malignancy Signal
news.summary: A detailed clinical review of the Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance package put Week-44 clinical remission at roughly 51% for both the 25 mg and 50 mg doses versus about 10% on placebo, with endoscopic remission of 41.5% (25 mg) and 47.7% (50 mg), and 50 mg converting about 37% of induction non-responders to remission. Critically for the June malignancy overhang, the expanded exposure showed stable exposure-adjusted safety rates and no apparent dose-dependent malignancy signal through Week 44.

news.headline: TCG Crossover and Chen Yu Report 7.0% Stake in Abivax After the July Offering
news.summary: Healthcare crossover investor TCG Crossover (Funds I and II, via managing partner Chen Yu) disclosed beneficial ownership of 6,007,834 ADSs, or 7.0% of Abivax, based on 86.09 million shares outstanding after the July 2, 2026 offering. It confirms that a dedicated biotech specialist held on through the large equity raise rather than selling into strength.

news.headline: Invus Entities Disclose 6.0% Beneficial Stake in Abivax
news.summary: Long-standing shareholder Invus (together with the Avicenna Fund) reported 4,825,759 ordinary shares and ADSs, equal to 6.0% of Abivax as of June 30, 2026. Alongside the TCG filing it rounds out an August picture of a stable, concentrated institutional register ahead of the NDA filing.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback and aligned with Abivax on the planned submission strategy, content and format of the obefazimod NDA in moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis. Abivax confirmed it remains on track to file its first-ever NDA by the end of 2026, removing a key procedural uncertainty.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $180 from $132, Maintains Overweight
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its target well above the prevailing share price, citing growing confidence in the obefazimod UC data package and the NDA timeline after the maintenance results and pre-NDA FDA feedback. It sits at the top of a sell-side range whose consensus target is now roughly $155-166 (Piper Sandler at $175).

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax hired four senior commercial executives covering marketing, patient services, sales operations and market access/pricing to build a standalone U.S. commercial organization ahead of a potential obefazimod launch. The move signals the company is preparing to launch on its own rather than depending on a partner or acquirer.

news.headline: Valerio Therapeutics Signs Exclusive Worldwide R&D Collaboration With Abivax for Next-Generation Immune-Mediated Disease Candidates
news.summary: Valerio Therapeutics announced a binding term sheet with Abivax for an exclusive worldwide research and development collaboration, receiving roughly EUR 2.4 million upfront plus development and commercial milestones, royalties on net sales and sublicensing revenue, subject to a definitive agreement. The partners will identify, design and preclinically evaluate next-generation candidates for immune-mediated inflammatory diseases, giving Abivax an early pipeline option beyond obefazimod.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results and pipeline update
catalysts.detail: Abivax normally reports half-year results in September. The update should refresh the post-raise cash position (guided into Q4 2029), R&D spend trajectory, NDA-preparation progress and the U.S. pre-launch commercial build-out. No exact date has been announced by the company yet.

catalysts.label: Full ABTECT maintenance data at a major gastroenterology congress
catalysts.detail: Abivax presented its ABTECT induction late-breaker at UEG Week in October 2025 and has a pattern of taking full datasets to autumn congresses. A detailed public presentation of the Week-44 maintenance efficacy and, above all, the malignancy/safety dataset would be the cleanest way to retire the June cancer-signal overhang. Neither the venue nor an abstract acceptance has been announced yet.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: After positive Phase 3 ABTECT induction and 44-week maintenance data and the constructive pre-NDA meeting on July 30, 2026, Abivax plans to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active UC in late Q4 2026. This is the single biggest near-term de-risking event and the gate that starts the FDA review clock.

catalysts.label: MAA submission to the EMA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax guided to filing a Marketing Authorization Application in Europe in the second half of 2026, contingent on the (now positive) 44-week maintenance data. Recent communication has emphasised the Q4 2026 FDA filing without restating a precise EMA date, so exact MAA timing remains unconfirmed and could slip into H1 2027.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD Crohn's disease 12-week induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027 (enrollment started Q3 2024). A positive readout opens a second large indication for the miR-124 mechanism, but it likely lands near or just after the March-2027 option expiry.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision on the obefazimod NDA
catalysts.detail: With a Q4 2026 filing and a standard review cycle, an FDA decision would fall roughly 10-12 months later, i.e. in H2 2027 - after the March-2027 call expiry. No PDUFA date exists yet because the NDA has not been submitted; this remains the ultimate approval and launch catalyst for the equity.

pulse: Abivax trades around $122 per ADS in late August 2026 (market cap roughly $10.5bn), fully recovered from the July financing wobble and sitting right on the $120 strike, with the average sell-side target near $155-166 and Morgan Stanley at $180. The story is now execution rather than science: Phase 3 ABTECT induction and Week-44 maintenance data are strong (about 51% remission vs 10% placebo, 37% of induction non-responders converted at 50 mg), the July 30 pre-NDA meeting locked in FDA alignment for an end-2026 NDA, and the $920m raise funds a solo U.S. launch into Q4 2029; the August 19 data review adding that there is no apparent dose-dependent malignancy signal further chips away at the June cancer-signal overhang. For the March-2027 $120 call the position is roughly at-the-money and depends on the Q4 2026 NDA landing on time, the September H1 report, a possible autumn congress presentation of the full safety dataset, and whether renewed takeover speculation re-rates the shares decisively above the strike before expiry.
